scope: HTML atob and btoa over the shared forgiving-base64 implementation.
notes: Both fixture and JSON corpus are exact upstream bytes at the existing html/webappapis and fetch directory revisions; their original headers and the shared BSD-3-Clause licence are retained.
The fixture registers 285 btoa cases, one atob setup promise test, and 94 atob cases after loading the pinned JSON corpus.

fetch_json is a test-only loader for exactly ../../../fetch/data-urls/resources/base64.json. The shared runner verifies the corpus hashes before fixture execution; no fetch implementation or host network is supplied.
The source atob, btoa and DOMException exports are the only Web API globals supplied. The test VM does not inherit host atob or btoa.
The adapter adds generate_tests with the pinned testharness.js receiver and argument behavior. Unsupported nonempty per-test properties fail explicitly.
Window and Worker global installation and Web IDL descriptor flags are outside this source-host fixture profile.
